brushes.role: Secondary curved bottom-left to top-right swipe

notes: The six brush files intentionally reuse the existing brush-stroke-01.png through brush-stroke-06.png filenames so they can overwrite the old reveal brush set.
Brushes should animate beyond the card bounds and across a motion region slightly larger than the card.
Use alternating diagonals, slight position/scale/rotation variance per pull, and progressive opacity/translation so the strokes feel painted rather than flashed.
The spin assets are additive and should be wired during the slower multi-rotation card-flip phase.
